• Application names, package identifiers, and daily foreground duration per active application.\n• Device presence heartbeats (last seen timestamp and battery/connection state).\n• Policy version acknowledgments.
Strict Privacy Guarantee — What We NEVER Collect

• NO browsing history or URLs visited on Android.
• NO personal chats, messages, SMS, or emails.
• NO contacts, phone numbers, or call recordings.
• NO photos, videos, or camera recordings.
• NO microphone audio or ambient listening.
• NO GPS or precise location tracking.
• NO keystrokes, passwords, or screen captures.
• NO VPN packet interception or network diversion.
How to Review or Change Permission

1. Tap 'Open Usage Access Settings' below.
2. Locate 'BalaKavach' in the list.
3. Toggle 'Permit usage access' ON or OFF.

If revoked, device pairing and policy visibility remain active, but screen time will be reported as unavailable.

• BalaKavach is an ordinary companion application that respects Android security boundaries.
• Ordinary apps cannot unilaterally shut down, freeze, or terminate third-party applications.
• Cannot lock the child out of device settings or prevent uninstallation.
• Parental website blocking rules are managed on the web dashboard and enforced on desktop Chrome browsers via the BalaKavach extension.
These settings are provided for local development and emulator testing. Do not modify in standard production environments.

• Android Emulator: Use http://10.0.2.2:5000/api/v1 to reach localhost:5000 on your development machine.
• Physical Device on LAN: Use your development machine's Wi-Fi IP address (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:5000/api/v1).
• Production: Requires HTTPS.
• Insecure HTTP is permitted only for local loopback addresses (10.0.2.2, 127.0.0.1, localhost).
